zh: 布朗大学（Brown University）成立于1764年，位于美国罗德岛州普罗维登斯市，是美国著名的私立研究型大学，也是常春藤联盟成员之一。学校在人文艺术、社会科学、自然科学、工程等领域享有盛誉，其开放的课程体系和创新的教育理念著称。布朗大学以其优秀的教学质量和自由的学术氛围，培养了大量各领域的杰出人才。
en: Brown University, founded in 1764, is a renowned private research university in Providence, Rhode Island, and a member of the Ivy League. It excels in humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, engineering, and more, known for its open curriculum and innovative educational philosophy. Known for its excellent teaching quality and free academic environment, Brown University has produced numerous talents across fields.
